notes.title: Official Publisher Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179360/6ccb3366b9b8861efb6414462f390b748ab7f9b3.png[/img]

[h2]Exciting News for Rise of The Newborns Fans! [/h2]

[h3]Hey Survivors! We have a big announcement to share today! [/h3]

We are thrilled to officially announce our partnership with [u][b]indie.io[/b][/u], who will be working with us to bring Rise of The Newborns to life on a whole new level! This partnership means a smoother journey towards the game's release, exciting new features, and a commitment to delivering an unforgettable experience in our post-apocalyptic distopian world.

[h3]What does this mean for you, our community?[/h3]
[olist]
[*] Enhanced Gameplay Experience: With [u][b]indie.io[/b][/u] support, we’re able to push the boundaries of what Rise of The Newborns can offer.
[*] Regular Updates: Stay tuned for more frequent updates on the game's progress, exclusive sneak peeks, and more behind-the-scenes content.
[*] Community Engagement: We’ll be hosting new events, AMAs, and community contests to celebrate our progress!
[*] We’ll continue to be active on all our social media channels, so make sure to follow us to never miss an update!
[/olist]
[h3]indie.io Publisher Page[/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/indieio]Check Out Some Other Great indie Titles[/url]

[h2]Dont Forget to Wishlist Rise Of The Newborns[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2958410/Rise_Of_Newborns/

[h1]Our Social Media Links[/h1]

Instagram: [url=https://www.instagram.com/riseofnewborns]@riseofnewborns[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://x.com/dodigamestudios]@dodigamestudios[/url]
YouTube: [url=https://www.youtube.com/dodigamestudios]dodigamestudios[/url]
Discord: [url=http://discord.gg/riseofnewborns]Join our community[/url]
We’re so excited about the journey ahead with [u][b]indie.io[/b][/u] and can’t wait to share more details with you soon. Keep an eye out for more updates as we get closer to release!

Thank you for your support, and let’s shape this world together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45179360/8cf7ed8c3b8a68b07009a92be7618b4bafbce431.png[/img]

Stay strong, stay safe, and keep surviving !
[u][b]Dodigamestudios Team[/b][/u]
